eps.o: Team Spidey finds pirate-y Spider Island and a cute new friend, Jeff the Land Shark.
Meet hero Captain America and new baddie, Hydro-Man.
When Lizard's potions turn him giant, he tries to take over Stark Tower and faces giant-sized Spidey.
Rhino gets ahold of White Tiger's gem and causes animal trouble in the city.
The Spidey bots help Team Spidey defeat Doc Ock's plans to launch a rocket.
The villains steal Black Panther's super battery and cause trouble in the city.
Lizard takes the iguanas from Lagarto Island and turns them into his minions.
Team Spidey must get their Dino-Web Crawler back after Rhino steals it.
Green Goblin and Rhino steal the Dino-Webs Tree House gem and turn into dinosaurs.
Spin and his abuela go on an unexpected adventure with Black Panther in his new Panther Pod.
Green Goblin and Rhino copy Lockjaw's teleportation power to cause trouble.
The heroes must work with Electro to save the day from Green Goblin's dino robot.
Team Spidey finds Pirate Web-Beard's long lost hideout on Spider Island
Green Goblin steals Captain America's shield
Lizard's potion turns him into a fire-breathing dragon
Peter and Gwen chase down Black Cat and Rhino after they steal Aunt May's jewelry
Rhino and Zola mistake butterfly chrysalises for jewels and steal them from the community center
Doc Ock's digging in the ocean threatens a deep-sea jellyfish habitat.
Green Goblin's clones threaten to ruin Halloween
Doc Ock's device controls the city's bats to steal things for her.
Spidey and Jeff save Spider Island from a pirate Green Goblin and Doc Ock.
Team Spidey swings to the rescue after Miles loses his little pet frog in the big city.

eps.t: A Squirrel Girl and Tippy Toe Pirate Adventure
eps.o: The Spidey team must get back their stolen Webs Ahoy pirate ship and rescue their friends.
The ghost of a legendary knight haunts the city.
Team Spidey swings to the rescue when Green Goblin steals the community feast.
Ant-Man and Spidey have a big problem when they are shrunk down in the Community Center backyard.
Hydro-Man, Green Goblin, and Rhino team up to try to ruin the Christmas Candlelight Walk tradition.
Trapster's holiday trap catches Santa and Team Spidey on Christmas Eve.

eps.t: The Treasure of Billie the Pirate
eps.o: Black Cat, Doc Ock and Rhino mistake Billie's beloved treasure for real jewels and steal it.
Jeff the Land Shark gets lost in the city and accidentally ends up with Zola.
When Herbie gets bonked and forgets who he is, he accidentally helps Rhino with his villainous ideas.
Spidey and Lizard get shrunk down by Lizard's potion and lost in the sewers.
Team Spidey helps reunite a family of dolphins that are under Doc Ock's mind control.
Green Goblin's Garbage Cannon messes up the beach on Earth Day.
Zola steals Captain America's motorcycle and races through the city.
WEB-Quarters gets shrunk down and lost in the city with Ghosty and Spin inside.
Team Spidey teams up with an unexpected friend, Pirate Web-Beard, to rescue Jeff the Land Shark.
Sandman and Hydro-Man compete to be the best villain and cause trouble in the city.
